summary: SLM Student Loan Trust 2003-7 filed Form 8-K reporting the furnishing of a preliminary remarketing memorandum for its Class A-5B Reset Rate Notes. This is a routine administrative update regarding the potential remarketing of existing notes, not a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. The filing provides pool information as of April 30, 2026, and does not involve any change in control, strategic review, or corporate event of the type that triggers a special-situations classification. Accordingly, it falls outside the defined categories.
